strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a second published comparator and a root statement proving agreement plus strict inclusion for it—most naturally the randomized proxy response-type model of ShingakiKuroki2023 as the no-selection/exogenous-treatment submodel—so the extension becomes a genuine comparator chain.

Add ShuWangLi2025 to related work and state precisely why its unrestricted PoC bounds neither encode proxy-factorization restrictions nor provide the target-rigidity atlas; compare its compatible-model polytope with the selected proxy-cycle fiber.

Promote the response-cycle atlas itself as a generic-class causal invariant by proving that it characterizes target constancy for every labeled four-type selected proxy model, rather than presenting the strict-extension theorem solely as an improvement over one anchor.

recommended_next_step: Revise the literature comparison and add a second formal comparator/reduction; the core otherwise remains a well-posed field-tier target with a genuine open structural classifier.
